[IDAT.3.3.7] **String model.** A string a JSON value holds contains no NUL
byte, because a `String` holds no U+0000 ([LSTR.1.1]), and libds refuses one
where it would enter ([LSTR.1.5]). `ds_json_new_string` must refuse `len`
bytes that hold a NUL with `DS_ERR_INVAL`, and `ds_json_object_set` must refuse
such a key the same way; the parser refuses a `\u0000` escape or a raw NUL as
malformed text. Built and returned strings are NUL-terminated, so
`ds_json_get_string`'s `*out_len` is the string's length in bytes, which
`strlen` also gives.
